factbook.naturalResources: petroleum, natural gas, iron ore, phosphates, uranium, lead, zinc
factbook.religions: Muslim (official; predominantly Sunni) 99%, other (includes Christian, Jewish, Ahmadi Muslim, Shia Muslim, Ibadi Muslim) <1% (2012 est.)
factbook.climate: arid to semiarid; mild, wet winters with hot, dry summers along coast; drier with cold winters and hot summers on high plateau; sirocco is a hot, dust/sand-laden wind especially common in summer
factbook.terrain: mostly high plateau and desert; Atlas Mountains in the far north and Hoggar Mountains in the south; narrow, discontinuous coastal plain
factbook.source: CIA World Factbook (public domain) via factbook/factbook.json — not an African primary source
